headline: JAYVANG DROPPED 153.69 WITH A 39-POINT QB ON HIS BENCH 🪑🚀

sections.heading: THE THIRD-STRAIGHT PURDY BENCHING 🪑🚀
sections.body:
jayvang100 scored 153.69 on Sunday, the highest total anybody has posted in 2026, and he did it with a 39.28-point quarterback sitting on his bench in street clothes. Brock Purdy. Week 1 he benched him for 27.1. Week 2 he benched him for 32.5. This week Purdy went 39.28 and Dak Prescott started for 20.94. LOL.

The man is now 99 bench points into a three-week bit and he keeps WINNING. Bijan Robinson went 34.30, Drake London 23.90, Michael Wilson chipped in 20.40 out of nowhere, and the final margin was 62.15 — the biggest beatdown of the week by eleven points. At this point Purdy isn't a mistake, he's a lifestyle. Start him or trade him, but stop making us watch. 😤

The body on the floor belongs to mouavang86, who lost by those 62.15 and has his own bench crime to answer for. More on that below, and it's worse. 💀

sections.heading: KEENENG STARTED THE RIGHT QUARTERBACK (EVERYONE SIT DOWN) 🫡
sections.body:
Two weeks of this league's finest comedy: Week 1, Keeneng starts Stafford for 4.1 while Trevor Lawrence goes 34.1 on the bench. Week 2, he corrects it, starts Lawrence for 6.2, and Stafford goes 35.0 on the bench. Combined 58.7 points of wrong answer, 0-2, phone privileges under review. 📵

Week 3: Trevor Lawrence 25.78. Matthew Stafford 24.90, benched. HE GOT IT RIGHT. By 0.88 points, but he got it right, and Erling Haaland won by 50.84 for his first W of the season. 🏆

Don't get comfortable — De'Von Achane started and produced 1.70, which is a number a running back has to work at. Juwan Johnson went 19.30 at tight end and Derrick Henry hammered 21.40, so the win was never in doubt. Three weeks, three quarterback decisions, one correct. That's a .333 average and in this league it's good enough for a trophy. 😂

sections.heading: EVZ132 WON THE WAIVER WIRE AND LOST THE GAME ANYWAY 💀
sections.body:
Somebody please check on Evz132. He picked Sam Darnold up off free agency and Darnold immediately posted 35.66, the second-best score in the entire league. He also put in a ZERO-dollar waiver claim on Jordan Love, got him, and Love went 22.48. Two quarterbacks, both free, 58.14 points between them. Best single waiver week anybody has had all season. ✅

He lost by 7.98. 🫠

Love's 22.48 came from the bench, obviously, and to finish the job Evz132 started the 49ers defense, who scored NEGATIVE 1.75. Deebo Samuel put up 15.40 in street clothes too. Jonathan Taylor gave him 8.20 and David Montgomery 5.80 from the two running back slots. I am DOOM is 1-2 with the third-most points in the league. Meanwhile cvang1990 rode Lamar Jackson's 24.44 and rookie Jeremiyah Love's 19.40 to 109.29 and the narrowest win of the week. 🪡

sections.heading: THE $55 QUARTERBACK AND THE BENCH OF ZEROS 🎻
sections.body:
muahuavang scored 66.84. Worst total of the week, worst total of the season by anybody. Ulysseus is 0-3 and has surrendered 396.54 points, fifty-six more than the next-worst team on earth. 😭

Remember he spent FIFTY-FIVE dollars of waiver budget on Bryce Young in Week 2. Bryce Young: 15.64. Meanwhile Caleb Williams — the man who dropped 41.3 for this exact roster in Week 1 — sat on the bench and scored 0.00. So did Jayden Reed. So did Rico Dowdle. So did Nico Collins. The top four players on his bench combined for 1.10 points, all of it Khalil Shakir. When your bench can't even betray you properly, that's a roster problem. 🫥

His second-leading scorer was Harrison Mevis, a kicker, with 16.00. Tetairoa McMillan went 2.70, TreVeyon Henderson 3.40, and the Patriots defense actively cost him 1.50 points. Fifty-five dollars, folks. He could have kept the money and lost by the same amount. 💸

sections.heading: WHO ACTUALLY SHOWED UP 🔥
sections.body:
Jahmyr Gibbs owns the week at 37.90 for YMVtheDAD, who paired it with Joe Burrow's 28.58 and a 15.00 game from Ryan Fitzgerald — a kicker he signed off the street days earlier — for a 30.52-point win. He also started Terrance Ferguson at tight end for 1.40 after spending six waiver dollars on him, because nobody in this league is allowed to have a completely clean week. 🙂

Behind Gibbs and Darnold: Bijan 34.30, Jaxon Smith-Njigba 30.36 for ChunckyM, Burrow 28.58, and Kirk Cousins 28.22 for KevinVang. That Cousins number deserves a parade — KevinVang grabbed him off free agency and dropped Jaxson Dart to do it, the same Dart who went 32.6 in Week 1 and 0.8 in Week 2. Reading the room, finally. Michelob Plus Ultra won by 38.03. 🍺

The Vikings defense went 23.65 for VangMushu, which would be a fun fact if it weren't the SECOND week in a row his leading scorer wore a team name instead of a player name. Drake Maye gave him 3.76, Saquon Barkley 8.50, and Chase Brown 7.90 — I Chase Brown Kids is 0-3 with the fewest points in the league. The team name is the only thing on the roster still performing. 🤡

sections.heading: DEFENSES, KICKERS, AND OTHER WAYS TO LOSE A GAME 🛑
sections.body:
Three defenses finished in the negative: the 49ers cost Evz132 1.75, the Patriots cost muahuavang 1.50, and the Bengals cost imbackbeech a full point — a defense he paid SEVEN dollars for on waivers two weeks ago. Tub89's Eagles rounded it out at 0.55, which is technically positive and spiritually not. 🗑️

imbackbeech is the real casualty here. He lost by 14.26 with Harold Fannin putting up 20.60 on his bench while Dalton Schultz — last week's celebrated pickup of the week, 20.0 points, clean decisive business — started and gave him 4.50. Add a kicker named Trey Smack contributing exactly 1.00 and that negative Bengals unit, and the Two-Minute Cumback Kingz are 1-2 with the second-most points in the league. Fannin alone flips the game. 😤

Special nod to ChunckyM, who benched Matthew Golden (18.50) AND Luther Burden (16.30) — 34.80 points of receiver, the exact same crime he committed in Week 1 — while starting Justice Hill for 3.30 and George Holani for 8.30, and won by 29.05 anyway. Josh Allen only managed 16.96 and it didn't matter. The Shadow Monarch leads the league at 366.90 points for and is still churning transactions like rent is due. He signed Austin Ekeler, dropped Travis Homer, re-signed Travis Homer, and added and dropped Oronde Gadsden inside the same week. Eleven moves a week is a personality, not a strategy. 🎡

sections.heading: NINE TEAMS. ONE RECORD. ZERO UNBEATENS. 📊
sections.body:
Read this slowly: NINE of the fourteen teams in this league are 2-1. All three Week 2 unbeatens — Tub89, Hvang94 and mouavang86 — lost on Sunday, so nobody is undefeated and the standings are a fourteen-car pileup. 🚗💥

ChunckyM sits on top of the pile on points (366.90), then jayvang100 (342.45), cvang1990, YMVtheDAD, Hvang94, KevinVang, mouavang86, Tub89 and Tonglue, all 2-1. Tub89 is in that group having scored 72.89 this week — second-worst total in the league — with Justin Jefferson posting 4.20 after his 7.0 last week and C.J. Stroud (13.68) and Keaton Mitchell (12.20) glued to the bench. Two and one. Hmoob Meka Hiluss is getting away with something. 🕵️

The 1-2 club is where the points went: imbackbeech (350.88), Keeneng (318.19) and Evz132 (317.33) have all outscored six teams with winning records. Fantasy football remains a schedule lottery with extra steps. 🎰

At the bottom, muahuavang and VangMushu are both 0-3 and have been outscored by a combined 208 points. Fourteen weeks left, one undefeated team fewer than we started the day with, and still nobody in this league can reliably identify their own best quarterback. Start your good players. 🤡
